title: Fix login approval gating: force fresh Firestore server read from users/{auth.uid} only

requirements.text: Update the Firebase login approval check so that every login attempt performs a fresh Firestore server read for the authenticated user profile at the exact document path `users/{auth.uid}` (where `auth.uid` is Firebase Auth `currentUser.uid` / `user.uid`), and uses that document’s `approved` boolean field as the sole source of truth for approval gating.

quotes: fresh Firestore read on every login

acceptanceCriteria: On each login attempt, the app fetches Firestore document `users/{uid}` where `uid` equals the authenticated Firebase user UID, using a server-forced read API (not a cache-eligible read).
If the Firestore document `users/{uid}` exists and `approved === true` (boolean), login succeeds and the pending-approval error is not shown.
If the Firestore document `users/{uid}` is missing OR `approved !== true`, the app signs the user out and shows the exact message: "Your account is pending admin approval."
Toggling `approved: false` → `true` in Firestore and attempting login again (without hard refresh) reflects the new approval state, proving there is no cached approval result.

requirements.text: Remove/disable any email-based profile lookup and any cached approval logic in the login flow; ensure there are no Firestore queries by email and no reuse of prior approval state between logins.

quotes: no cached or email-based approval logic

acceptanceCriteria: The login flow does not query Firestore by email (no `where('email'...)`, no reads of `users` collection to match email) and only reads `doc(db, 'users', uid)`.

Approval gating does not rely on any stored/cached value (e.g., localStorage/sessionStorage/React state/React Query cache) to determine `approved` during login; it always uses the fresh Firestore server read result for that attempt.

requirements.text: Update the LIVE smoke test/deployment verification guidance to explicitly validate the new login behavior (fresh server read every login, `users/{auth.uid}` only, no email lookup, no cached approval state) and reference the expected console/log indicators for troubleshooting.

quotes: I’ll test immediately after the new build is live.
Please confirm: ... Firestore is fetched fresh on every login

acceptanceCriteria: Smoke test documentation includes a step proving that an admin flipping `approved` in Firestore affects the very next login attempt without a hard refresh.
Smoke test documentation includes a step to confirm the document path is `users/{auth.uid}` and that no email-based lookups occur.

constraints: Frontend files under `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, and `frontend/src/components/ui` are immutable and must not be edited.
Keep the approval-gated access model backed by Firestore user records; do not introduce new auth providers beyond the existing Firebase Email/Password + Internet Identity setup.
nonGoals: Do not add new product features (e.g., chat UI, dashboards) as part of this fix.
Do not change Firestore security rules unless required to support reading `users/{auth.uid}` (the goal is to fix client login logic).
Do not add password reset email functionality (Forgot Password remains admin-managed).
